The recent resignation of Srinagar MP Aga Syed Ruhullah Mehdi underscores the growing ideological splits.

title: Niraj scripts history with World C'ships bronze, secures LA 2028 Olympic quota
description: Niraj Kumar won a bronze medal in the men's 50m rifle 3 positions at the ISSF World Championships. This achievement secured an Olympic quota for India ahead of the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics. Earlier, Jaypal Malviya had also secured a quota place by winning silver in the men's 10m air pistol event. Niraj also contributed to India's bronze in the team event alongside Aishwary Pratap Singh Tomar and Akhil Sheoran.

title: Jeremy Renner's former $8m Hollywood land now hosts mansion listed for $99m
description: A luxury mansion in Los Angeles has been relisted for $99 million after a significant price reduction. Previously priced at $125 million, the property has undergone a substantial adjustment to attract buyers. The mansion features seven bedrooms, 12 bathrooms, and spans 22,000 square feet on over an acre of land. It also includes amenities like private access to Runyon Canyon and a 100-foot infinity pool.

title: Neil Patrick Harris hosts New York gala raising over $2m for animal protection
Harry Styles' tote bag sparks $40,000 sales, funds 1,300 therapy sessions
description: Photographed in London, Harry Styles carried a tote bag linked to a cause close to the heart—mental health support. Founded by Elena Kilgore, The Other People Fund provides essential therapy sessions for individuals in need. Initially kicking off as a small clothing project, the initiative garnered remarkable attention from Styles' fanbase, raising an impressive $40,000, equating to around 1,300 affordable therapy sessions.

title: 4 coaches of Chauri Chaura Express derail at Kanpur Central station
description: Four coaches of the Chauri Chaura Express derailed shortly after departing from Kanpur Central railway station. The incident occurred on Wednesday evening, approximately two minutes after the train's departure. No passengers were reported injured or killed during the derailment, which involved coaches B4, B5, B6, and B7. Railway authorities initiated relief operations and provided helpline numbers for assistance. The cause of the derailment remains under investigation by senior railway officials.

Jensen Huang’s affair flaunted his photos, helped move 240,000 ‘banned’ chips to China
description: Alice Huang, the suspected Chinese spy Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with, posted photos with him on WeChat and claimed he celebrated her birthday with gifts, The Information reports. A web of firms tied to her allegedly secured $7.5 billion in Nvidia AI chips and moved 240,000 banned H100 and H200 GPUs into China. Nvidia's board is now investigating the CEO's relationship with the Megaspeed executive.

After being escorted out following a verbal altercation involving his son, Carroll filed a lawsuit. The Kentucky Court of Appeals revived his defamation claim against former athletic director Charlotte Marshall. Carroll's claims regarding interference with his career were dismissed because he secured a promotion shortly afterward.

title: Travis Kelce defies retirement talk as Chiefs’ 6-2 start silences his critics
description: Travis Kelce, now 37, scored a rushing touchdown, becoming the oldest tight end to achieve this milestone. During the Chiefs’ recent game, they defeated the Jets, ending a two-game losing streak. Kelce leads the team in receiving yards and has shown improved performance compared to last season, averaging 14.6 yards per catch. He and Patrick Mahomes surpassed a significant passing record shared previously with Philip Rivers and Antonio Gates.

title: ‘Good-looking’, ‘good physique’: ABVP flags 'chats' seeking DU girls for Diljit concert
description: An invitation circulating on WhatsApp seeks female students for a concert, offering payments and VIP access. The Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad is demanding an investigation into the alleged recruitment tactics. Accusations against a student involve inducements linked to NRI contacts and objectification based on appearance. Ramanujan College has suspended the student pending further inquiries and investigations. Allegations remain unverified despite concerns raised by various student organizations.

title: Ladakh bans protests ahead of polls: Wangchuk warns of fresh agitation against elections
From Shah Bano to 1999 Congress revolt: 5 political moments in Sonia Gandhi’s memoir
description: Sonia Gandhi's memoir unveils the intersections of her personal life and political career. Delving into episodes like the Shah Bano case and the Babri Masjid events, she offers poignant reflections on her husband Rajiv Gandhi's assassination and its aftermath. Furthermore, she candidly shares the hurdles faced during her Congress leadership amidst internal strife, creating a rich narrative about India's political evolution.

title: Why Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei wanted OpenAI to stop taking Peter Thiel’s money
description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei once urged OpenAI to stop accepting money from billionaire Peter Thiel, calling him "morally worthy of condemnation" over his $1.25 million donation to Donald Trump's 2016 campaign. The messages were posted on OpenAI's internal chat months after Amodei joined, and they have resurfaced as Anthropic pitches its Nasdaq IPO to investors. The twist: Thiel's Founders Fund later invested about $1.25 billion in Anthropic, the AI company Amodei co-founded.

description: In a significant trade, Punjab Kings have acquired Hardik Pandya from Mumbai Indians, undeniably enhancing their batting lineup for IPL 2027. However, the loss of Arshdeep Singh to Mumbai raises questions about Punjab's bowling strength. Hardik's presence will bring power and experience to their batting, while Arshdeep joins a strong bowling unit led by Jasprit Bumrah, creating an exciting rivalry between the franchises.

description: In a remarkable turn of events, former Indian hockey captain MM Somaya has reclaimed his cherished 1980 Olympic gold medal, stolen from his residence. The Bengaluru Police made significant strides in the investigation, capturing two suspects despite the initial lack of evidence. Grateful for their persistence, Somaya highlighted the deep emotional significance of the medal, symbolic of his unwavering passion and years of commitment to the sport.

title: 'Let us have a debate': Akhilesh Yadav challenges BJP over demonetisation
description: Akhilesh Yadav has renewed his criticism of the 2016 demonetisation, describing it as a major corruption scandal. He alleges that the currency ban has adversely affected banks and small traders, particularly MSMEs. Yadav challenges the government's banking reforms and blames demonetisation for increasing cash circulation. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath responds by accusing opposition parties of past corruption and recruitment irregularities.

title: Watch: Netanyahu's wife, ex-Israel PM in heated exchange as Bibi delivers Parl speech
description: Sara Netanyahu confronted Naftali Bennett during a parliamentary address, interrupting the prime minister's call for unity. The argument escalated when Bennett raised questions about allegations involving Netanyahu's advisers and Qatar. Sara responded from her seat, leading to a public shouting match. The incident occurred while tensions were high regarding the investigations into the October 7 attacks. This unusual event highlighted the political discord surrounding Netanyahu's leadership.

title: Mumbai to get 5 more air monitoring stations, all inside gardens
description: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation plans to set up five additional air quality monitoring stations across Mumbai. The total investment for these new stations will be Rs 17.50 crore, with planned hourly monitoring. Locations include parks and recreational grounds in various neighborhoods not currently monitored by other networks. Data from the new stations will be available on the BMC portal linked to the Central Pollution Control Board server.

title: INS Betwa set for major propulsion upgrade under Rs 498 crore deal
‘He surely knew’: Broad takes aim at coach Lehmann as Sandpapergate row erupts again
description: Chris Broad has harshly criticised Darren Lehmann for seemingly being oblivious to the ball-tampering scandal of 2018. Usman Khawaja, a former Australian player, has disclosed in his autobiography that the entire team was aware of the misconduct during their tour of South Africa. Broad insists that Lehmann must be held accountable for his ignorance in this matter, sparking renewed discussion about the scandal.

title: ‘Makes much stronger’: Irfan explains how Arshdeep trade could transform MI
description: The Mumbai Indians have secured a trade for Arshdeep Singh from the Punjab Kings, bolstering their bowling unit significantly. This strategic acquisition allows them to utilise Jasprit Bumrah more efficiently during matches. With solid pace options in their arsenal, MI gain the flexibility to adjust their overseas player squad and even deploy an all-Indian pace attack, fundamentally reshaping their tactics for the upcoming IPL season.

title: 'My captain Shreyas, my coach Ricky': Hardik's first comment after joining PBKS
description: Hardik Pandya has moved from Mumbai Indians (MI) to Punjab Kings for Rs 18 crore. In return, PBKS have traded fast bowler Arshdeep Singh to Mumbai Indians. The trade has been completed ahead of the 2027 IPL season. Pandya's new fee of Rs 18 crore is higher than his earlier fee of Rs 16.35 crore.

title: Arshdeep Singh's first message after joining Mumbai Indians - Watch
description: Mumbai Indians, the five-time champions, have signed the left-arm fast bowler in exchange for their captain Hardik Pandya, who will now play for Punjab Kings. Arshdeep shared his first message after joining Mumbai Indians in a video posted by the franchise on social media.

title: At executive meeting post affair revelation, Nvidia CEO apologised but took no questions
Mother Dairy, Amul hike milk rates by upto Rs 6 per litre from tomorrow; check prices
description: As of November 12, milk prices in the Delhi-NCR region are set to rise as Mother Dairy and Amul implement increases ranging from Rs 2 to Rs 6 across their milk variants. This adjustment is necessary due to a combination of dwindling milk supplies and soaring production costs driven by inflation.

title: 15-year-old stabbed to death barely 25 steps from home, near police outpost in Kanpur
description: A 15-year-old cloth shop worker was stabbed to death near his home and close to a police outpost in Kanpur’s Fazalganj area on Tuesday night. Police have detained one accused and formed five teams to trace the others. Preliminary investigation suggests a dispute involving a girl may have led to the killing.

title: Move abroad or quit by December: IBM ends visa sponsorship for most consultants
description: IBM is ending US visa and Green card sponsorship for most roles in IBM Consulting, its largest division with over 150,000 employees. Affected visa holders can work for IBM outside the US or leave by year-end, Bloomberg reported. The move follows the Trump administration's H-1B visa crackdown, which includes a $100,000 fee and last month's suspension of Microsoft, Infosys and TCS from the PERM green card process.

title: Possessive partner, adoption twist: What cops found in Kolkata techie murder case
description: Sanchalika Basu has been arrested for allegedly murdering her live-in partner Sarthak Sarkar during an argument. Their relationship had experienced strain due to Sanchalika's possessiveness over Sarthak's social media interactions. Police investigations revealed that Sanchalika's mother, Moumita, is also under scrutiny for her potential involvement. Neighbors reported hearing loud arguments shortly before the incident occurred. The authorities are awaiting the post-mortem results to establish further details regarding the case.

title: Body cams now mandatory for cops checking vehicles in Gurgaon
Russian paraglider hangs from high-tension wires for 2.5 hours in Himachal
description: A solo paraglider from Russia, Evakin Alexei, experienced a harrowing ordeal in Himachal Pradesh's Mandi district as he became ensnared in high-tension power lines. Rescuers acted promptly, utilizing a crane to safely retrieve him after a two-hour suspension caused by gusty winds. Fortunately, he escaped without injuries. This alarming event highlights the rising risks associated with paragliding in the region.

title: How sound of celebration may lead to silent, but long-term health hazard
description: Diwali celebrations lead to increased noise pollution, affecting health in various ways. Children are notably at risk of hearing loss and anxiety. Doctors recommend maintaining a safe distance from firecrackers and using ear protection. The detrimental effects of noise pollution extend beyond Diwali, occurring throughout the year in the city. Continuous exposure raises concerns regarding public health, particularly for children and sensitive individuals.
